integrity: The proof identifies signed paperfolding prefix balance with the Hamming weight of binary reflected Gray codes. A recursive interval classification gives exact possible lengths and starting congruences. The odd-part rule proves phase-invariant factors, their exact multiplicities and density. Standalone verification enumerates every interval at finite dyadic depths and checks independent word constructions.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the standard regular paperfolding word and nonempty Dyck factors. Does not classify generalized paperfolding instructions, nesting-level spectra, or higher-dimensional parentheses. The known length-support criterion alone does not contain the new exact occurrence and distinct-factor classification.
title: Exact Dyck-factor starting positions and multiplicities in the paperfolding word
